sourceTreatment.final: Key to transparent PNG with despill and preserved margin. Mask soft pastel-pink watercolor paper to each extracted silhouette, then add an irregular ripped-white contour, hot-pink offset and very soft paper shadow in Remotion; never use a rectangular backing.
